name: Murdering
overview: The Scriptures clearly establish the sanctity of human life by commanding, "Thou shalt not kill" (Exodus 20:13; Deuteronomy 5:17), underscoring the seriousness of murder. Leviticus 24:17 further emphasizes the gravity of taking a life by prescribing the death penalty for anyone who kills another person, reflecting God's just response to such a violation. This teaching upholds the divine order of life and includes specific considerations such as the grave sin of children murdering their parents.
